defects.after: `fd.KIND_A` is the formula of part A: the column `aggregate_GBps` of the csv. The text adds how the binary computed this column: the sum of the bytes of all threads / the longest per-thread time [Ref13].
defects.evidence: facts_data.py line 436 reads `KIND_A = 'aggregate_GBps column of the csv (sum of bytes / longest per-thread time)'`, facts.json holds this text in `meta.rate_kinds.part_A`, and bandwidth.orig.c line 441 computes `agg = (double)total / max_el / 1e9`; the row gave the bwx formula in full and the part A formula without its division.
